shortBulletSummary: Crypto market sentiment has turned bearish, with funding rates declining on major exchanges.
Bitcoin is holding steady around $64K, though caution remains due to Fed rate hike fears and geopolitical events.
Spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded their first net inflows in eight weeks, signaling renewed institutional interest.
The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data is due this week, with persistent Fed rate hike fears impacting markets.
Middle East tensions are escalating, with the Strait of Hormuz reportedly closed, driving up oil prices.
